meta_description: Software developer from Norway building native tools in Rust and Zig, and full-stack web apps in TypeScript. Computer Engineering student at NTNU.
hero_lede: I build fast, native tools in {#highlight}Rust{/highlight} and {#highlight}Zig{/highlight}, and full-stack web apps in TypeScript. I’m studying Computer Engineering at NTNU and spent the summer building data pipelines at Norsk Byggedata.
hero_portrait_alt: Aleksander in aviator sunglasses against a blue sky
experience_lede: From my hometown of Moss to an Air Force base above the Arctic Circle, and on to writing software in Trondheim and Oslo.
role_byggedata_summary: Built scrapers that collect building-permit records from Norwegian municipalities, a ranking system that prioritizes construction projects, and an iOS app that syncs with the database.
role_tihlde_summary: I’m part of Index, the student team that builds the platforms for TIHLDE, a computer science student association at NTNU. I’ve merged 84 pull requests across the new tihlde.org, its predecessor, a real-time voting app and the member app.
role_air_force_summary: Twelve months of national service, working with military aviation operations.
role_sibus_summary: Developed game mods for Grand Theft Auto V on the FiveM platform.
projects_lede: Mostly native tools and language runtimes in Rust and Zig. All of it is open source.
project_berth_summary: A native Docker Desktop alternative, written in Rust with GPUI, the GPU-accelerated UI framework behind the Zed editor.
project_openconnect_summary: Signs in to Cisco AnyConnect VPNs with single sign-on, then hands the session to OpenConnect. The login window only appears when you need to type something.
project_cnvs_summary: A command-line client for Canvas LMS that borrows your browser’s signed-in session through the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
project_jvm_summary: A Java virtual machine written from scratch to learn Zig, redesigning my earlier one in Rust. Both parse class files and run Hello World.
project_nrpc_summary: Type-safe calls between client and server scripts on FiveM, inspired by tRPC. Published on npm.
project_quickjs_summary: Zig bindings for the QuickJS engine.
project_rice_summary: My Hyprland desktop, with a Quickshell bar.
about_bio_intro: {#highlight}I’m Aleksander, a software developer from Moss, Norway.{/highlight} I wrote my first program at 11 and my first website at 14, and I’ve been building things ever since.
about_bio_now: These days I’m happiest close to the metal. I’ve written Java virtual machines in Rust and Zig, a WebAssembly interpreter and a native desktop app for Docker. I still love the web, and I build TIHLDE’s platforms in TypeScript with the Index team.
about_bio_space: Outside of code I follow space exploration and rocketry closely. One day I want to work where software and spaceflight meet.
part_avionics_detail: Side projects in Rust and Zig
contact_lede: Have a role, a project or a question? Reach out on LinkedIn, or see what I’m working on over on GitHub.
footer_built_with: Built with TanStack Start, hosted on Cloudflare.
